-- name: #a_storm_giant_architect
-- Generated by scripts/quests/velious-backlog.mjs; edit server/internal/quest/velious_backlog_quests.json.
-- P99: https://wiki.project1999.com/Living_Granite (sha256 e7a76510c08bfe03c71b92635130a725d6bf7dcb1849bfaf5c10e42e18d42bd8)
-- Original: server/internal/quest/upstream/projecteq/wakening/#a_storm_giant_architect.pl (sha256 a5f100ff3a9b5bd045583e6ed403520bde1d195743f9f5d171b4e31734d0b171)
-- P99-reviewed Velious content. Quest faction gates deliberately bypassed; actual faction rewards retained.
local item_lib = require("items")

function event_say(e)
  if e.message:findi("hail") then
    e.self:Say("Hmmm, I didn't know refuse could speak. Are you here to annoy me or are you planning on making yourself useful, if the latter is even possible?")
  elseif e.message:findi("make myself useful") then
    e.self:Say("A feeble creature like yourself is near worthless. If you must insist on serving the mighty Kromzek then go to the caverns of the geonids and bring me four blocks of living granite so that I may perform some tests on its value as a resource in the expansion of Kael.")
  end
end

function event_trade(e)
  if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24872, item2 = 24872, item3 = 24872, item4 = 24872 }) then
    e.self:Say("So you proved to be of value after all, take this for your work. Don't let it go to your head.")
    e.other:AddEXP(25000)
    e.other:SummonItem(24877)
    e.other:Faction(448, 10, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, 10, 0)
    e.other:Faction(429, 10, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, 10, 0)
  end
  -- Return unrelated and surplus offers on both accepted and rejected trades.
  item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
